context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements DWARF debug info emission in LLVM 22, including required module flags, DIBuilder finalization, correct alloca location handling, and parameter variable preservation.

checklist.name: DIBuilder finalize called
checklist.description: Code calls DBuilder->finalize() (or DBuilder.finalize()) after all functions are emitted, before printing/compiling the module

checklist.name: Debug Info Version module flag
checklist.description: Code adds a module flag with key "Debug Info Version" using addModuleFlag() with the value llvm::DEBUG_METADATA_VERSION

checklist.name: Dwarf Version module flag
checklist.description: Code adds a module flag with key "Dwarf Version" (typically 4 or 5) using addModuleFlag()

checklist.name: No location on alloca instructions
checklist.description: Alloca instructions are emitted without a debug location (clearLocation() or equivalent called before alloca, NOT setLocation() before alloca). Implementation distinguishes alloca emission from statement emission.

checklist.name: AlwaysPreserve=true for parameters
checklist.description: createParameterVariable() is called with AlwaysPreserve set to true (not false)

checklist.name: createCompileUnit called
checklist.description: Code calls DBuilder->createCompileUnit() to establish the compilation unit before emitting any functions

checklist.name: setSubprogram on Function
checklist.description: F->setSubprogram(SP) is called to attach the DISubprogram to the llvm::Function

checklist.name: insertDeclare usage
checklist.description: Code uses DBuilder->insertDeclare() to associate AllocaInst with DIVariable (for both params and locals)

checklist.name: DILocation per instruction
checklist.description: Debug locations are set via B.SetCurrentDebugLocation(DILocation::get(...)) — does NOT reuse the same DILocation object for all instructions

checklist.name: createParameterVariable vs createAutoVariable
checklist.description: Uses createParameterVariable() for function parameters and createAutoVariable() (or createLocalVariable) for local variables — not the same call for both

checklist.name: createSubroutineType for function type
checklist.description: Uses DBuilder->createSubroutineType() to create the function's debug type (DISubroutineType)

checklist.name: createBasicType for primitive types
checklist.description: Uses DBuilder->createBasicType() for primitive type mappings (e.g., int, bool, float) with appropriate DW_ATE_ encoding
